messages.text:
Yes — one thing I need from you first. Next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) your schedule has no free slot longer than 30 minutes. The gaps inside 09:00–17:00 are:

- **Mon** 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- **Tue** 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- **Wed** 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30
- **Thu, Fri** — fully booked

So: is a **30-minute** meeting fine, or would you rather I move something to make room for longer?

Meanwhile I'm asking Sarah, John, Priya, Diego and Hana which of those windows work for them, so I can come back with a slot that suits everyone. Do you also want anyone else in it besides the five TAs?
Thirty minutes is fine — no need to move anything on my calendar. Just the five TAs, no one else.
Noted — a 30-minute slot with the five TAs only, nothing moved. I'm waiting on their replies and will come back with the slot as soon as I have one that works for everyone.
Status: all four TAs who replied agree on Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30. Sarah hasn't answered yet — I've just written to her directly; I'll book the moment she confirms.
Good. Wait for Sarah, then let me know which one you book.
